gre_general.value: GRE general test is not considered as part of application review.
gre_general.quote: No. We do not require GRE scores. If you choose to include the GRE mathematics subject test in your application, we will factor your score into our review. However we do not consider the GRE general test or other subject tests as part of our application review.

gre_subject.value: GRE mathematics subject test score factored into review if included.
gre_subject.quote: However, students coming from lesser known schools or with non-traditional paths are encouraged to include a GRE mathematics subject test score in their applications.

funding.value: All admitted students receive comprehensive support with full tuition remission, competitive stipend, and health insurance.
funding.quote: Everyone, regardless of nationality or country of residence, admitted to our PhD Programs receives a comprehensive support package that includes full tuition remission, a competitive stipend, and health and dental insurance.

entry_route.value: Bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited U.S. university or equivalent required.
entry_route.quote: You hold a bachelor’s degree from a regionally accredited university in the United States or the equivalent of a U.S. bachelor’s degree from an officially recognized university in another qualifying Anglophone country where English is both the only official language and the language of instruction.
